items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: when he came out of the Service, I hired him to join me then. And, at that time, I had 6 saxophones

ctx.x: Cause when I added Ridley and all them on sax, well, they was taking other peoples places.
Were there any other effects of the war years on your band? Or, anything else that you felt as a band leader that you felt changed things for you?
